title: feat: the sweep shape, and guards that no longer run twice
headline: Every review role stays, the plan gap check becomes a step of the plan skill, and a reviewer start is counted once and only when it runs, so a project with old guard entries can sweep again.
alignment: v1.31.0 lands the owner's sweep-shape pick on the three trial builds' numbers and fixes the guard faults two projects reported, each reproduced on the released 1.30.1 first.

items.text: The plan gap check is a step of the plan skill: one fresh reviewer reads the design and the code it changes with a fixed brief, before the owner's yes, and each high it names goes into the design.
items.where: Highs named before any code, per build
items.after: A step every planned feature takes

items.text: A feature or launch-gate sweep report counts its highs by the layer that caught them (plan, CI, sweep, escaped), and the report audit holds it to that.
items.before: Recounted by hand from old reports
items.after: One line in every feature report

items.text: The sweep guard counts a reviewer start once, however often it is checked, and never for a call another guard refused, so a held start no longer spends its role's one slot.
items.where: A sweep in a project with old guard entries
items.before: Every reviewer refused as started already

items.text: Install takes out every settings entry that runs a kit guard itself, with a backup, as it already did for 1.25.0's entry; status and the session-start notice name any that remain.
A sweep round whose recorded starts never ran can be closed as none ran; a start counts as run only when a reviewer transcript names it.
Two plain reads are no longer refused: a cd followed by a piped read, and a quoted pattern read as a command. Every planted write and delete is still held.
The recall test names its model and effort, pinned to what the owner's sessions really run, and a test holds every team role file to a named model.
The team build skill gives the scanner model's real price against the top model on both sides of a 100K-token prompt, and scanners keep their prompts under it.
The packet writer names a preview cut apart from a missing label, so a closeout no longer looks for a label that is there.
Rule 11 and the orientation protocol name the Active Plan beside the files the Resume Point names, as the check prints them; recall keys v10 follow.

verification: Each guard and sweep fix has a test that fails on the code before it; K48 to K50 and K54 were first reproduced on the released 1.30.1 in a throwaway install.
The delete guard's planted cases: 765 of 765, the new read cases and the bracket and question-mark names among them.
The coverage map, timed on a small PR: unit tests 1m03s against 2m46s for a full run.

decisions.why: The owner's bar for the cut, set before the trials, held on one condition of three: highs only the leaving roles found, and highs that escaped, were seen in the trial builds.

decisions.decision: The plan check lives in the plan skill, not a rule module
decisions.why: It is a step of planning, and the rule module had no room; the sweep report's Layers line measures it.

decisions.decision: Install removes old guard entries, not only names them
decisions.why: Install already removed 1.25.0's entry the same way; the owner said yes to removal beside naming.

tests.flips: declared tests on main and on this branch; the PR run gives the final count
